Tigzi d ik d-itsmga tirra n wuzzal n wuzzal n wuzzal n wuzzal.
Di kraygat asrir, bḍu s umata {num_total_units} n yigrawen ɣef yifurken {field_names}.

S umdya, '[A7 B7 C6]' bḍu 7 n yigrawen i A, 7 i B, d 6 i C.
